Schema/config pushes refresh local src/bm.d.ts once, after the final batch write and after the reloaded runtime is seen healthy. The CLI waits up to 25 seconds for reload; if the baseline, target, batch or reload cannot be verified, it preserves the existing declarations and prints a warning. When the app rejected the reload (check_app reports its last reload failed), push and deploy print that error and exit non-zero instead; see api(at:"recovery") rejected_reload. A failed type download also preserves the file. Source writes remain persisted; verify runtime behavior, then run benmore types explicitly. This observation does not attest exact source bytes or exclude concurrent writers.
Explicit refresh: benmore types [app] --out PATH [--env dev|prod]. Inside a workspace, omit app and the .benmore/app marker selects the deployment.
src/bm.d.ts is generated augmentation retained locally for offline editor use; never hand-edit it.
